newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns BBBpi to Aoyama Trading, Aoki Int'l.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns BBBpi to Aoyama Trading, Aoki Int'l.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Monday that it had assigned BBBpi ratings to Japanese retailers Aoyama Trading Co Ltd and Aoki International Co Ltd.
The "pi" rating is based on public information.
The two companies specialise in men's suits and operate large stores in the suburbs.

S&P said in a statement that it views their business style as highly competitive thanks to skilled merchandising, which enhances operating efficiency and simultaneously poses barriers to new entrants.

However, these specialised retailers are exposed to risks from narrow product lines, weaker consumer spending and severe pricing pressure, though these factors are somewhat offset by steady replacement demand given the role of suits as a staple of men's fashion in Japan. S&P said.
S&P said that Aoyama and Aoki are expected to maintain their leading position in men's suits retailing, even though department stores are expected to continue to challenge that segment of the market.
